title: DCP Multi-Packet Collective Helstrom vs. Separable Tilted and X-Basis Decision Bridge
claims: For known-target binary hypothesis testing H_0: s = 0 vs H_1: s = s^* across M >= 2 distinct-header packets with sin(theta_m) != 0, D_{tr}^{coll} > D_{TV}^{sep-Hel} > D_{TV}^{(X^{\otimes M})}.
Under unknown sign symmetrization s^* <-> -s^*, the single-copy sin(theta_m) Y-component cancels and collapses the single-copy Helstrom bias to gamma_m * sin^2(theta_m / 2).
